attractions.name: Hon Thom Cable Car + Aquatopia Water Park
attractions.shortDescription: World’s longest sea cable car (~7.9 km) to Hon Thom island water park + Exotica — the south-cluster must-do from Khem.
attractions.whyKids: 8–12 water-slide heaven; cable views thrill all ages. Be on first cars (midday break typical).
attractions.reviewSummary: Hebrew Gate06 + Katy blogs call Hon Thom a must. Ticket typically includes Aquatopia + Exotica.
attractions.distanceFromHotel: ~10 min to Sunset Town cable terminal (hotel cites)

attractions.name: VinWonders Phu Quoc
attractions.shortDescription: Vietnam’s largest theme park — rides, Typhoon World, aquarium, shows. One ambitious north mega-day from Khem.
attractions.whyKids: 12yo thrills (height gates); 8–9 love water + themed zones. Bring swimsuits. Do NOT stack with Hon Thom same day.
attractions.reviewSummary: Gate06 + Katy Hebrew highlight; ~55–75+ min each way from Khem — plan early start + private car.

priceFamilyEst.note: estimate day Safari 850k/650k; combo VW+Safari same day 1.5M/1.1M; 2-day combo ~1.7M/1.3M — verify

attractions.name: Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc
attractions.shortDescription: Open-habitat safari bus (lions, tigers, giraffes) + walkable zoo + shows — best as same north trip as VinWonders over 2 days.
attractions.whyKids: Hebrew families rate highly; optional Junior Zoo Keeper ~5–12 (book slots).
attractions.reviewSummary: Hours ~09:00–16:00 last entry often 15:00; animals more active early.
attractions.distanceFromHotel: Same long haul as VinWonders (~55–75+ min)

attractions.name: Snorkeling & island boat day (An Thoi archipelago)
attractions.shortDescription: Best ‘wow sea day’ — coral reefs south of island (Gam Ghi, May Rut, etc.). Prefer private/max-10 over party boats.
attractions.whyKids: Dec dry season = best visibility; lifejackets + kid gear; New World closer to An Thoi ports.
attractions.reviewSummary: Klook group ~US$30–60/pp; private family boats often multi-million VND — get live quote for 5.
attractions.distanceFromHotel: Advantage — closer to An Thoi ports; many south pickups

attractions.name: Grand World Phu Quoc (north evening)
attractions.shortDescription: Venice canals, free street shows, optional gondola / Teddy Bear Museum / Quintessence show — worth it only if already north for parks.
attractions.whyKids: Walkable ‘never sleeps’ village; Teddy Bear = AC rain escape; late return from Khem (~70 min) is hard with kids.
attractions.reviewSummary: Grounds free; combine Safari AM → Grand World PM if doing north mega-trip.
attractions.distanceFromHotel: 55–75+ min — only with north park day

attractions.shortDescription: Iconic photo + sunset/evening stroll — often tied to Sun World ticket windows; check 2026 access.
attractions.whyKids: Quick wow photo with Sunset Town visit / Hon Thom day.
attractions.reviewSummary: Paired with south cluster; free public viewing areas often available.

attractions.name: Ong Lang Beach sunset cove
attractions.shortDescription: Quieter west mid-island cove — golden sunset; water shoes for rocky/coral patches at low tide.
attractions.whyKids: Different beach half-day when Khem feels familiar; not a must.
attractions.reviewSummary: B-tier soft outing; ~40–55 min from New World.

priceFamilyEst.note: quote hotel — do not assume; historically expensive at some island 5★

attractions.name: Resort NYE gala or quiet villa countdown
attractions.shortDescription: Safest with 8/9/12 — hotel dinner + soft countdown, OR private pool + room service + early fireworks watch then bed.
attractions.whyKids: After Hanoi→Tam Coc→Ha Long→Hoi An→Da Nang, quiet villa NYE is a valid choice at 3BR New World.
attractions.reviewSummary: Ask New World in writing: compulsory gala? kids pricing? dress code? Historical 5★ galas often multi-million VND/adult.

attractions.name: Pepper farm short stop
attractions.shortDescription: Phu Quoc pepper is famous — 20–40 min educational smell/taste stop if en route.
attractions.whyKids: Mild interest unless they like tasting; don’t build a day around it.
attractions.reviewSummary: C-tier filler; combine with town run.

attractions.name: Suoi Tranh Waterfall
attractions.shortDescription: Jungle stream walk — Dec dry season may be a trickle vs wet-season roar; still shaded nature if restless.
attractions.whyKids: Light adventure; don’t expect big waterfall in Dec.
attractions.reviewSummary: phuquocgo notes; C-tier for this season.
